scripts.fetch-spec: curl -fsSL -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN" https://raw.githubusercontent.com/${{ values.repoOwner }}/${{ values.apiEntityName }}/main/openapi.yaml -o src/openapi.yaml
curl -fsSL -H "PRIVATE-TOKEN: $GITLAB_TOKEN" https://${{ values.gitlabHost }}/${{ values.repoOwner }}/${{ values.apiEntityName }}/-/raw/main/openapi.yaml -o src/openapi.yaml
scripts.prebuild: npm run fetch-spec && npm run generate-api
